detail.longDescription: Jasper and Copy.ai were two of the first AI text generators to hit the market in the pre-ChatGPT days. (Remember a world without ChatGPT? Me neither.) But once chatbots became ubiquitous and ridiculously powerful, there wasn't much competitive advantage in being a slightly-prettier text generator.
